correctness.rationale: Reconstructed every face of the Alexander dual: complete one-skeleton, 6N induced-path triangles, N square tetrahedra, and no larger faces by 3E=20 contradiction. Verified independent free-face collapses to the torus with N(N-13)/2 extra loops. The explicit oriented torus fundamental cycle is translation-invariant. For nonidentity translations all fixed oriented chains vanish except swapped edges when the shift has order two; Hopf traces and sign-twisted equivariant Alexander duality give the displayed characters. Averaging gives each quotient formula. The embedded standard-library checker was actually executed on the five parameter pairs with exact rational boundary elimination and passed. No finite computation is used to infer an infinite statement.
